name: Shinohara Akari
source:
She is 22 years old and lives in Tokyo. Even though she's the protagonist's oldest friend, her IRL life is a complete mystery. She goes online late at night, in addition during the day on weekdays. She seems to know a lot of things, not just games. She sometimes surprises the protagonist with some enlightening words.

[Avatar: Tae]
A cheerful leader on the Internet that loves to talk about erotic subjects. She looks like a loli, but talks like an old man. She was even able to convince the protagonist she was an old man IRL with proof. She'll sometimes change her avatar based on her mood, but will always make it a point to show her panties to the protagonist.
